name: Ugoki Animation
description: Ugoki Animation is a minimalist portfolio theme crafted for independent animation studios, directors, and craft-led ateliers. Inspired by editorial archives and digital atelier aesthetics, it features an inset dark window hero, key-drawing marquee strip, credit-ledger case walls, and contact-sheet project pull-backs. Designed for the WordPress block editor with quiet typography, film-grain imagery, and responsive frame-accurate layouts.
